scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: Personalized Task Dependency Graphs for Mitigating Signal Erosion in Multi-Task Recommendation
papers.authors: Liu, Fuyuan, Wu, Tiandeng, Fang, Yaqun, Zhou, Wei, Zhou, Zehao, Chen, Wenping, Mei, Qishun, Zhou, Jiaxin, Chang, Heng, Cao, Yi, Ding, Jiandong
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.04862v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Optimizing multiple conversion objectives is a core challenge in industrial recommendation, often limited by signal erosion in rigid architectures. Existing Multi-Task Learning (MTL) methods typically enforce uniform dependency strengths across a static conversion funnel, overlooking how task correlations naturally vary based on item characteristics. Hierarchical message passing along these fixed chains leads to cumulative signal attenuation, which degrades performance on sparse, deep-funnel objectives. To address this, we propose the Personalized Task Dependency Graphs (PTDG). While respecting necessary physical causal constraints (e.g., Click -> Pay), PTDG dynamically "rewires" the intensity of dependency pathways for each item via low-rank approximation to ensure structural robustness. We implement a GCN-based propagation with hard causal masking to establish adaptive information shortcuts. Additionally, we introduce an Adaptive Progr
papers.summary: PTDG 针对多任务推荐中深层转化信号沿固定漏斗衰减的问题，用低秩分解生成实例相关任务图，在因果掩码内传播信息，并按标签稀疏度逐步屏蔽共享参数。工业数据平均 AUC 为 0.8878，线上两周实验相对 MMoE 实现 CVR 提升 1.2%、eCPM 提升 1.9%。
papers.key_insight: 任务依赖强度可以随用户、内容和场景变化，硬性行为顺序仍应由业务规则约束。社区搜索可先在点击、评论、收藏等多目标头上试验动态图，重点检查稀疏目标与负反馈；论文额外延迟为 8 毫秒，且密集点击任务没有普遍胜出，不能直接承诺 CTR 同幅增长。
papers.evidence_note: 原文表 2、表 3、4.5 节；A/B 为 10% 对照与 10% 实验，各两周，p<0.05。
papers.preference_reason: 主题加分 0；按业务相关性与实用性维度给予轻微偏好加分，未跨轨选择。
papers.scoring_rationale: 多目标 CTR/CVR 与 UGC 点击、评论等目标直接相关；公开基准、20 次重复与线上 A/B 证据。

papers.title: MURAL: Multimodal Uncertainty-aware Recommendation via Adaptive edge Learning
papers.authors: Mousavi, Ahmad, Alikhani, Majid, Lee, Yeon-Chang, Corizzo, Roberto, Abdollahinejad, Yeganeh
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.04574v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal Graph Neural Networks have become standard for recommendation by augmenting sparse interaction data with content features. Yet current architectures face two bottlenecks: structural rigidity, from a reliance on static precomputed similarity graphs that cannot adapt to evolving preferences; and semantic fragility, where noisy modality signals are indiscriminately fused, distorting the collaborative signal. We propose MURAL (Multimodal Uncertainty-aware Recommendation via Adaptive edge Learning), a unified framework that shifts multimodal recommendation from fixed structural augmentation to dynamic topology discovery. To address structural rigidity, an Adaptive Edge Learner combines a differentiable retrieval-augmented strategy with an approximate nearest neighbor search to discover latent item-item correlations that are both semantically adaptive and computationally scalable (O(NlogN)). To address semantic fragility, an Uncerta
papers.summary: MURAL 针对静态物品图和多模态噪声，用 HNSW 找候选邻居，再学习边权，并结合模态重要性与不确定性融合表征。TikTok 全量排序 Recall@20 达到 0.1221，对比最强基线 DiffCL 的 0.1158，相对提升约 5.44%；Amazon 两个数据集也取得更高指标。
papers.key_insight: 内容相似度与行为相关性可以分开建模，再由推荐监督学习物品连边。社区图文帖子可复用这一设计，先离线构图并与固定余弦图对照，同时按噪声程度检查文本、图片权重；移除梯度截断后 TikTok Recall@20 降至 0.1091，说明内容分支的梯度隔离值得单独验证。
papers.evidence_note: 原文表 2 和表 3；五次独立试验，论文报告 p<0.01；仅离线实验，无生产 A/B。
papers.preference_reason: 主题加分 0；按业务相关性与实用性维度给予轻微偏好加分，未跨轨选择。
papers.scoring_rationale: 多模态协同推荐与噪声抑制；三个全量排序基准及消融，实施路径清晰。

papers.title: Do Sequential Recommendation Benchmarks Really Require Higher-Order Sequence Modelling?
papers.authors: Petrov, Aleksandr V., Chandar, Praveen, Bennett, Paul N., Bouchard, Hugues, Lalmas, Mounia
papers.abstract: Sequential recommenders increasingly use language-model architectures designed to capture complex, context-dependent interactions. Yet it remains unclear whether widely used benchmarks actually require this modelling capacity. We investigate this question using two simple, recency-weighted pairwise probes that do not learn higher-order sequence representations: Sequential Rules (SeqRules) and our Probabilistic Collaborative Transition Model (PCTM). Using the evaluation protocol of eSASRec, at least one probe exceeds our eSASRec reproduction by 15-38% on three Amazon datasets and by 4.4% on MovieLens-1M, but trails it by 27.3% on MovieLens-20M. On the four remaining datasets, at least one probe also outperforms our sampled-softmax SASRec reproduction by 9-28%, suggesting that these widely used benchmarks are poorly suited to measuring gains from higher-order sequence modelling. More broadly, comparing Transformer-based models against strong recency-weighted pairwise probes provides a concrete test of whether a benchmark can meaningfully measure gains from higher-order sequence modelling.
papers.summary: 作者用带时间衰减的 Sequential Rules 与概率协同转移模型 PCTM，检验常用序列推荐基准是否需要高阶交互。在一致评测协议下，较强的成对基线在三个 Amazon 数据集超过 eSASRec 约 15%–38%，在 MovieLens-1M 高 4.4%，却在 MovieLens-20M 低 27.3%。
papers.key_insight: 社区搜索引入复杂用户序列模型前，应加入近期行为加权的成对转移基线，并统一时间切分、已看内容过滤和全量候选评测。若 Transformer 无法超过该基线，现有数据不足以证明高阶建模带来收益；论文仅验证五个离线基准，这一结论不代表线上个性化不需要长序列。
papers.evidence_note: 原文表 1；官方代码 spotify-research/sequential-capacity-probes。研究仍有工作进展属性。
papers.preference_reason: 主题加分 0；按业务相关性与实用性维度给予轻微偏好加分，未跨轨选择。
papers.scoring_rationale: 强成对转移基线审视序列推荐评测；官方代码及完整候选排序可复现。

papers.title: Beyond Co-purchase Relation: Evolution of Complementary Recommendations at Allegro
papers.authors: Osowska-Kurczab, Aleksandra, Nazarko, Klaudia, Kosturová, Eliška, Wojciechowska, Lidia, Bień, Michał
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.05063v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: When a customer adds a professional camera to their cart, should the system suggest a matching lens, a generic tripod, or another camera body? Complementary Product Recommendation is vital for comprehensive basket building, yet standard models often fail to distinguish between items that are merely bought together and those that truly work together. In this paper, we present AlleCompanion: a production-scale retrieval framework deployed at Allegro.com that transforms noisy behavioural signals into precise semantic compatibility. We mitigate the intrinsic noise in large-scale co-purchase traffic by combining data-level filtering heuristics with a category-constrained Two Tower architecture. Within this framework, the Category Adapter guides the model in the embedding space, constraining candidates within logically complementary boundaries. Since modelling authentic user behaviour at scale is inherently difficult, we introduce ComCat, a mu
papers.summary: Allegro 的 AlleCompanion 结合行为清洗、带类别适配器的双塔模型与 ComCat 类别映射，区分共购、互补和替代关系。线上商品页自然推荐关联 GMV 在 Web 和 App 分别提升 8.05%、9.35%；购物车对应提升 21.25%、15.73%，但部分购买前场景没有收益。
papers.key_insight: 推荐目标中的“相关”需要按入口拆解：互补、替代与同类内容未必适合相同场景。社区帖子相关推荐可借鉴类别约束层与向量模型分离的方式，保留广泛行为训练数据，在候选筛选中表达意图；过强专家过滤曾使 Web 访问转化下降 0.28%，应按入口做独立实验。
papers.evidence_note: 原文表 5 和 4.4 节；GMV 指 carousel 归因 GMV，相对各自生产基线，显著值 p<0.005；NVIDIA 作者注明研究在 Allegro 完成。
papers.preference_reason: 主题加分 0；按业务相关性与实用性维度给予轻微偏好加分，未跨轨选择。
papers.scoring_rationale: 互补推荐、物品关系与冷启动；生产系统证据充分，但购物篮业务与 UGC 搜索有差异。

papers.title: Latent-Aligned Reasoning for Multimodal Recommendation
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.04645v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in cross-modal understanding, yet a fundamental challenge persists when applying them to recommendation: as representations propagate through multi-step reasoning, both visual and textual signals progressively attenuate - a phenomenon we term cross-modal dilution. To address this, we propose LARK (Latent-Aligned Reasoning frameworK), a two-stage latent reasoning framework with complementary alignment mechanisms within a single VLM. In the first stage, learnable latent tokens are interleaved with multi-step chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and explicitly aligned with a frozen vision encoder, serving as visual checkpoints that preserve perceptual details throughout the reasoning chain. In the second stage, the latent representations are projected via a bridge MLP and trained with item-to-item contrastive learning; to prevent the reasoning semantics from fadi
papers.summary: LARK 针对多模态推荐中的推理信号衰减，在潜在推理阶段加入视觉对齐，再通过物品对比学习和推理文本对齐输出稠密向量。三组 Amazon 数据及一组工业数据验证了效果；工业数据 LightGCN 的 Recall@20 达到 0.0548，较 AlignRec 相对提升 10.0%。
papers.key_insight: 该方法可作为离线物品特征生成器接入现有推荐模型，在线主要消费缓存向量。对社区图文内容，可先比较原始特征与双重对齐特征，再按冷门帖子分桶检查收益；论文去掉两种对齐后 Baby Recall@20 下降 11.8%，但线上 A/B 仍属于后续计划。
papers.evidence_note: 原文 3.4 节说明离线物品嵌入及 LightGCN/MLP 下游；表 2、表 3 和第 5 节。核心是多模态物品表征，并非在线生成推荐列表。

papers.scoring_rationale: 离线生成物品向量并接入传统推荐模型；需要额外视觉语言训练，尚无线上试验。

papers.title: Building a User Foundation Model for the Open Web
papers.authors: Vernier, Solal, Arisoy, Ivan Can, Barlier, Merwan, Škrlj, Blaž
papers.abstract: User foundation models have demonstrated strong results in e-commerce and social recommendation, but most industrial deployments assume environments where user identity is stable and persistent. Open-web real-time bidding (RTB) operates on a structurally different data distribution: user identity is fragmented and non-persistent across browsing sessions, and the availability of browsing history depends on user privacy choices. Consequently, a significant portion of traffic carries no historical data, and available records often consist of relatively short, disjointed sessions. As a result, historical signals in this domain are typically represented as aggregated counters and recency buckets, leaving the sequential structure unexploited. To address this limitation, we present a user foundation model that applies self-supervised learning on user browsing histories and show that the learned representation improves multiple downstream production tasks, demonstrating the viability of this approach on the open web. We pre-train a Transformer encoder with masked language modeling and a sequence-level contrastive objective, then fine-tune it on the click prediction task. We optimize the encoder's pre-training pipeline with an LLM-in-the-loop search over a curated catalog of reviewable, code-level edits (lifters), instantiating the LLM-as-optimizer paradigm in an industrial setting. The same encoder representation yields +1.197% RIG on the production bid win-rate model and +1.354% RIG on the production CTR ranker; a 7-day live A/B test confirms +2.13% CTR, -1.13% eCPC (80% CI excluding zero on both metrics).
papers.summary: Teads 面向身份不连续、历史稀疏的开放网络广告，用掩码学习和序列对比预训练用户编码器，再微调点击目标并通过适配器接入排序。生产 CTR 模型 RIG 相对提升 1.354%；七天 A/B 的 CTR 提升 2.13%、eCPC 降低 1.13%，作者使用的是 80% 置信区间。
papers.key_insight: 对社区访客和短历史用户，可先独立训练轻量用户编码器，再将向量接入现有 CTR 排序，以隔离表征与排序架构的贡献。应分别评估无历史和有历史流量，避免仅在活跃用户上验证；论文的统计标准低于常见 95% 区间，复现时需要重新核算样本量和不确定性。
papers.evidence_note: 原文表 3、表 4、表 6；七天 50/50 A/B，80% CI 不跨零；首次发布日期 2026-07-30，属于 90 天内 Web 补充。
papers.preference_reason: 主题加分 0；按业务相关性与实用性维度给予轻微偏好加分，未跨轨选择。
papers.scoring_rationale: 短且不连续历史的 CTR 表征可迁移；生产验证采用 80% 置信区间，证据评分保守。
